hypotheses.enonce: The rsETH reserve of the Aave v3 core market was administratively frozen (isFrozen 0 -> 1 at block 24 908 723, 2026-04-18 19:03:59 UTC): withdrawals are blocked from that instant.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: isFrozen never flips in the window, or the freeze lands elsewhere than the dated block
hypotheses.support_criterion: an isFrozen transition measured at a dated block (binary search, 14 steps, 24 908 722 -> 24 908 723)

hypotheses.enonce: The value retained by the oracle diverges from the market price (about -31 %): valuing the position on the oracle overstates the realisable value of the collateral.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: the market price tracks the oracle within the documented tolerance
hypotheses.support_criterion: the documented market price (1 686 USD) sits far below the retained oracle readings (2 513-2 526 USD) over the same window

hypotheses.enonce: The supply cap saturation (99.999 % at 2026-04-18 18:00 UTC) preceded the freeze and constrained the market: no new supply could enter before the administrative freeze.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: cap_ratio far below saturation, or the freeze strictly precedes the saturation
hypotheses.support_criterion: cap_ratio_max measured at 2026-04-18T18:00:00Z, strictly before the freeze instant

hypotheses.enonce: Counter-intuitive competitor: the reserve is blocked by a full utilisation of the market (a 100 % utilisation leaves no cash to withdraw) - the freeze is only a symptom of a liquidity squeeze.
hypotheses.refutation_criterion: a measured utilisation of about 0.008 % (no borrowing on the reserve), as the archived series shows
hypotheses.support_criterion: a measured utilisation of the rsETH reserve close to 100 % around the freeze

lacunes.question: Can the documented market price (1 686 USD) be confirmed from an archived market series? The RPC data layer documents the retained price, not the exit price.
What was the oracle freshness at the freeze? latestRoundData() reverts on the capped rsETH/ETH/USD feed, so no updatedAt is readable.
What is the exact bad debt per account? The incident report gives 123.7 / 230.1 M USD, but the per-account debt ledger is out of this data layer.
Was any realisable value left for the frozen collateral? No liquid venue is readable for a stolen/unbacked rsETH.
